ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure marks elements such as cities, rivers, contour lines, the Great Wall, and provincial boundaries; within the figure, “Yan'an” can be seen located in the southern part of the shown region, the 110°E meridian is on the right, the 37°N parallel is in the upper part, the Great Wall is drawn near the north, and contour lines are marked in many places at about 1000 meters. method.method_draft: 先描述图像中延安、经纬线和长城等定位信息，判定图示区域为陕北黄土高原附近；再结合题干要求回答“水资源状况如何”；利用黄土高原北部降水少、蒸发强、径流不足的地理知识，归纳造成经济发展落后的水资源原因是水资源短缺。
